General Motors Seeks Outside CEO Contenders to Succeed Mary Barra

Automaker weighs external executives alongside internal contenders as longtime chief lays groundwork for handover

By

and

General Motors GM -0.46 % decrease; down pointing triangle is working with an executive search firm to identify possible outside candidates to succeed Chief Executive Mary Barra as the automaker prepares for a future beyond its longest-serving leader in modern times.

The automaker is also eyeing a crop of internal candidates, according to people familiar with the matter.
